name: Grace Slear
biography: New York City based multifaceted artist Grace Slear most recently wrapped the world premiere of The Queen Of Versailles starring Kristin Chenoweth and directed by Michael Arden. She is also featured in the Paramount Plus movie musical Mean Girls written by Tina Fey, where Grace was cast as a featured dancer and a featured actress. In 2021 they celebrated their Broadway debut in Jagged Little Pill as a swing and understudying the principal role of Jo. Graces additional credits include the film She Came to Me (Rebecca Miller/Protagonist Pictures), Footloose (Walter Bobbie/Kennedy Center), The Tattooed Lady (Max Vernon/Philadelphia Theater Company) and the developmental reading of How to Build a Bomb (Doug Wright/ David Clement). Notable dance credits include The Met Gala 2021 and 2024 (Andy Blankenbuehler Michael Arden) and Kyle Hanagami’s 2023 YouTube Brandcast.
